report:
Toe, left hallux, excision

Received in formalin is a piece of tissue labelled left hallux, measuring 0.9 x 0.7 x 0.5 cm. All embedded in 1 block after decalcification.

(1) Lesion, all embedded, decalcified.

Sections show trabecular bone with a cap of fibrocartilaginous tissue. The features are those of a subungual exostosis. There is no evidence of malignancy.

TOE, left hallux, excision - SUBUNGUAL EXOSTOSIS
